en.name: TP-Link EAP225 Access Point
en.shortDescription: AC1350 ceiling-mount access point with Omada SDN support.
en.description:
## TP-Link EAP225

An AC1350 dual-band access point designed for ceiling mounting in offices, shops and hotels.

- Dual-band 802.11ac, up to 1350 Mbps combined
- Free Omada software-defined networking controller
- 802.3af PoE powered
